ja: • 大阪万博開催に伴う古都京都・奈良への観光客増加に備えて1969年から大量投入。
• 当初は２両編成、のちに中間車を加えた４両編成・６両編成も登場。
• 本商品はスナックコーナー撤去後の２両編成を再現できる。
・動力ユニット3対応・走行台車T対応・2両入り
en: • Large quantities were introduced in 1969 in preparation for the increase in tourists to the ancient capitals of Kyoto and Nara due to the Osaka Expo.
• Initially, 2-car configurations were introduced, and later 4-car and 6-car configurations with an intermediate car also appeared.
• This product can reproduce the two-car train after the snack corner has been removed.
・Compatible with power unit 3 ・Compatible with running trolley T ・Contains 2 cars
